title: Agriculture
description: Ozonation in agriculture increases yields, extends product shelf life and ensures biosecurity. An eco-friendly alternative to chemical pesticides and preservatives.

aquaculture.title: Aquaculture (RAS)
aquaculture.shortDesc: Water treatment and fish disease control in recirculating aquaculture systems
aquaculture.content:
In fish farming, ozonation is used at all production stages: from water preparation to storage of harvest. Ozone disinfects water, controls fish diseases and extends storage life.

In recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS), ozonation removes heavy metal ions, microalgae, toxins, fungal spores, microbes and cysts. Water turbidity drops significantly and unpleasant odors disappear.

Ozone destroys up to 99% of pathogenic organisms: viruses, bacteria and parasitic protozoa. This reduces fish morbidity and mortality and allows higher stocking density.

Recommended ozone dose is about 13 g per 1 kg of feed. In clean water, fish gain weight faster and the production cycle shortens.

intro.paragraph1: In fish farming, ozonation is used at all production stages: from water preparation to storage of finished product. Ozone disinfects water, controls fish diseases and significantly shortens the production cycle.
intro.paragraph2: In recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS), ozonation removes heavy metal ions, microalgae, toxins, fungal spores, microbes and cysts from water. Water turbidity is significantly reduced, unpleasant odors disappear, and optimal conditions for fish growth are created.

dosage.title: Recommended dosage:
dosage.text: 13 g of ozone per 1 kg of feed. This dosage achieves an optimal balance between disinfection effectiveness and fish safety.

advantages.title: Advantages of ozonation in RAS
items: Water disinfection from viruses, bacteria and parasitic protozoa
Oxidation of organic compounds and ammonia
Removal of water turbidity and color
Coagulation of fine suspended particles for improved filtration
Saturation of water with dissolved oxygen
Reduction of fresh water consumption by 40-60%

waterQuality.title: Effect of ozone on water quality
waterQuality.intro: Water quality is a critical factor for successful fish farming. Ozonation provides comprehensive water treatment, eliminating both biological and chemical contaminants.
waterQuality.tableCaption: Effectiveness of water ozonation in RAS
waterQuality.note: In clean ozonated water, fish gain weight faster, the production cycle is shortened by 20-30%, and feed conversion improves by 10-15%.

pathogens.title: Fish disease control
pathogens.intro: Ozone destroys up to 99% of pathogenic organisms: viruses, bacteria and parasitic protozoa. This reduces fish morbidity, decreases mortality and allows higher stocking density.
pathogens.tableCaption: Effectiveness of ozone against fish pathogens

fishTypes.title: Ozonation regimes for different fish species
fishTypes.intro: Different fish species have different sensitivity to residual ozone. It is important to select an optimal regime for each species, ensuring disinfection effectiveness while maintaining fish safety.

warning.title: Warning:
warning.text: Residual ozone in fish tank water should not exceed 0.01-0.02 mg/l. Use ORP sensors and automatic dosing systems for control.

steps.title: Water intake from tank
steps.description: Water with fish waste products is directed to treatment

steps.title: Mechanical filtration
steps.description: Removal of large suspended particles on drum or belt filter

steps.title: Ozone contact chamber
steps.description: Ozone injection through diffusers or injectors, contact time 3-5 minutes

steps.title: Biofiltration
steps.description: Final treatment for ammonia and nitrites in biological filter

steps.title: Degassing
steps.description: Removal of residual ozone in degasser or through activated carbon

economic.title: Economic effect
economic.intro: Implementation of ozonation in RAS provides comprehensive economic benefits through improved growing performance and reduced operating costs.
economic.tableCaption: Economic indicators of ozonation in RAS
